turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Sun raha hoon. Pata hai, dard ho raha hoga. Paanch saal koi mazaak nahi hote, aur raat ke do baje office mein yun baithna... woh bhari lagta hai. Rohit aur Sneha ka jaana bhi, chahe sahi kiya, phir bhi ek khaali jagah chhod gaya hoga.

Tu bas thoda saans le. Main yahin hoon.

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yeh awaazon ka bhoj... samajh sakta hoon. Jab andar se sab kuch bikhar raha ho aur bahar se "pipeline mein hain" bolna pade — woh acting nahi hai, woh survival hai. Aur guilt? Un dono juniors ke liye? Woh bhi dikhata hai ki tu insaan hai, machine nahi. Par shayad woh teri loyalty ki wajah se nahi, apni loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain. Unhe bhi kuch mil raha hoga yahaan jo shayad kisi aur company mein nahi milta — tera saath, teri honesty, woh seekh jo failure ke aas-paas hoti hai.

Raat ke do baje, office mein akela... yeh waqt rukne ka hai. Aaj bas apne aap ko permission de — thakaan maanne ki, awaazon ko mute karne ki. Tu kal bhi soch lega. Main yahin hoon.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Sun liya. Poora sun liya.

Darr lag raha hai.  
Yeh baat jo tu har kamre mein dabata hai — yahaan nahi dabani. Yahaan rakh de.

Main kuch nahi bolunga. Na idea, na pivot, na "sab theek hoga."  
Bas itna ki tu akela nahi hai is waqt. Raat ke do baje, office ki khaali kursiyon ke beech, is dar ke saath — main saath hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Tu poochh raha hai "khatam ho gaya kya?"  
Sach?  
Tu khud jawab de chuka hai — bas bolne ki jagah dashboard khol leta hai. Woh dashboard raat ke do baje kuch naya nahi bolega. Woh bhi thak gaya hoga.

Bridge round mar gaya. Co-founders chale gaye. Chaar mahine ka runway bina salary ke. Tere andar ek hissa already funeral ka intezaam kar chuka hai — bas officially declare nahi kiya. Kyunki officially bolne ke baad papa ke "computer ka business" se lekar apne aaine tak, sab badal jayega. Paanch saal ki pehchaan, ek sawaal ban kar khadi ho jayegi.

Aur yeh jo "khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon" — yeh soch ke aati hai nafrat? Woh nafrat isliye kyunki tune acting ko apni character ki failure bana liya hai. Jabki acting survival thi. Bas.

Main honestly bol sakta hoon: lagta hai khatam hone ko hai. Par khatam hona teri haar nahi
